title: Shelly, 27
body: Corn maze designer by day, corn maze solver by night. I've never been lost. The corn guides me. 847 mazes designed. 0 complaints (that I acknowledge). My corn maze won 'Most Disorienting' three years running.
summary: Corn maze designer. 847 mazes designed. The corn guides her.

prompts.question: My ideal first date involves...
prompts.answer: Getting lost together in one of my mazes. Don't worry, I'll find the way out. Eventually. Time is relative in the corn.

prompts.question: A skill I'm proud of...
prompts.answer: I can navigate any corn maze blindfolded. The stalks tell me which way to go. You think I'm joking.

prompts.question: My love language is...
prompts.answer: Quality time. Specifically, quality time spent surrounded by 8-foot tall corn plants in a labyrinth of my own design.
